notes.title: Dreamhack Beyond Game Awards!
notes.notes:
Death Unphased is included in the Dreamhack Beyond Game Awards running from December 15-21! Check out all the amazing games in the event here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/DreamHackBeyondGameAwards2023]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/DreamHackBeyondGameAwards2023[/url]!

In Death Unphased, you phase through walls with your dash! Phase through spikes/enemies for an extra dash and blaze a path to the exit.

Search for the fastest route to earn the S rank on each level, but it won't be obvious. Disappearing dash walls, charging platforms, teleporter orbs, and more will complicate your path.

Scratch that precision platforming, puzzle-solving, and speedrunning itch. Utilize the power of the phase dash in Death Unphased!

notes.title: Releasing on October 2!
notes.notes:
Death Unphased will release on October 2, 2023 at 9:00 AM PT!

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game and played the playtest and demo. Prepare yourself for challenges and phasing fun!

notes.title: Aug. 24 News
notes.notes:
Hello, I wanted to share a brief update on how development is progressing!

So far, development has been focused on designing levels and refining the mechanics shown previously in the playtest weekly levels. Currently, all the mechanics are in the game and 53 levels have been implemented. There's still some bug-fixing and polish to be added, but almost all the functionality is there. 

It feels like the final stretch and the current target for release will be October this year!

I'll hold off from spoiling too much of the game, since there's going to be some crazy levels and some creative speedrun routes. But below are a couple work-in-progress gifs as a teaser and thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game and is patiently waiting for the release.

notes.title: S Rank Playthrough Broadcast for Dreamhack Beyond!
notes.notes:
Death Unphased is part of the Dreamhack Beyond Summer Indie Showcase running from August 18-27: https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/40157993/view/6533084468191083425.

To celebrate, there will be a pre-recorded demo playthrough (no commentary) demonstrating how to earn all the S ranks!

With the freedom to phase through walls and spikes with your dash, you can invent your own path in Death Unphased. But be careful - hovering ghosts, unphaseable acid spikes, and more will complicate the route to the exit. It's up to you to search for the fastest way to speedrun each level.

Development remains focused on levels and mechanics for release. But for now, you can enjoy the demo and wishlist the game!

notes.title: July 11 Updates
notes.notes:
Demo v1.0.6 and Playtest v0.6.0 are now live! More movement expression, more pathing options, and more speed with the new movement changes. As a result, secret Z ranks have been added to each level that will challenge you to go even faster than the S ranks. The reworked options menu now has tabs and a new option to disable checkpoints to help you with speedrunning.

Shared changelog (demo + playtest):
- Updated wall jump to be slightly more expressive - directional input affects movement during wall jump
- Updated dash to be slightly more expressive - directional input affects movement while dashing
- Added ground jump cancel out of dash (only if player isn't touching enemy/spike)
- Added wall jump cancel out of dash
- Added phase through wall jump (can now wall jump off of wall while on phasing on the way out)
- Improved falling speed consistency with gravity decay after full jump hold
- Updated dash to move in the last pressed direction if there's no directional input
- Added sound effects for ground/wall jump cancel and phase through wall jump
- Reworked options menu to have separate tabs
- Added option to disable checkpoints
- Added hidden Z rank times (even faster than the S ranks)
- Added Z rank time display (if achieved) in the level select menu
- Added Z rank time display (if achieved) in the level end menu
- Reworked level 13 and also updated background
- Minor adjustments/fixes to level 9 and level 14
- Updated S rank time for level 4
- Fixed phase through bug where player could get stuck in floor/walls

None of the S rank times require the player to execute a ground jump cancel, wall jump cancel, or phase through wall jump. However, a Z rank time will likely require the player to use these advanced techniques.

Play now and submit feedback!

The weekly levels are only for the playtest in order to get feedback and iterate on new mechanics!
